CREATE TYPE cd_dep AS(a integer,b text); CREATE TABLE cd_dep_rows(v cd_dep); CREATE VIEW cd_field AS SELECT (v).b AS b FROM cd_dep_rows
ALTER TYPE cd_dep DROP ATTRIBUTE b
ALTER TYPE cd_dep DROP ATTRIBUTE b CASCADE
SELECT to_regclass('cd_field'), '(2)'::cd_dep
CREATE TYPE cd_const AS(a integer,b text); CREATE VIEW cd_const_field AS SELECT ('(1,x)'::cd_const).b AS b
ALTER TYPE cd_const DROP ATTRIBUTE b
ALTER TYPE cd_const DROP ATTRIBUTE b CASCADE
CREATE SEQUENCE cd_calls; CREATE TYPE cd_effect AS(a integer,b bigint); CREATE VIEW cd_constructor AS SELECT ROW(1,nextval('cd_calls'))::cd_effect AS v
ALTER TYPE cd_effect DROP ATTRIBUTE b
SELECT * FROM cd_constructor; SELECT is_called FROM cd_calls
ALTER TYPE cd_effect ADD ATTRIBUTE b bigint
SELECT * FROM cd_constructor; SELECT is_called FROM cd_calls

CREATE TYPE cd_inner AS(a integer,b text); CREATE DOMAIN cd_domain AS cd_inner; CREATE TYPE cd_outer AS(v cd_domain,items cd_inner[]); CREATE TABLE cd_nested(id integer,v cd_outer,items cd_inner[]); INSERT INTO cd_nested VALUES(1,ROW(ROW(7,'seven')::cd_inner,ARRAY[ROW(8,'eight')::cd_inner,NULL])::cd_outer,ARRAY[ROW(9,'nine')::cd_inner,NULL]),(2,NULL,NULL)
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW cd_materialized AS SELECT id,v,items FROM cd_nested
ALTER TYPE cd_inner DROP ATTRIBUTE b
SELECT id,v,items FROM cd_nested ORDER BY id
SELECT id,v,items FROM cd_materialized ORDER BY id
CREATE TYPE cd_default AS(a integer,b text); CREATE TABLE cd_defaults(v cd_default DEFAULT '(5,five)'::cd_default)
ALTER TYPE cd_default DROP ATTRIBUTE b
INSERT INTO cd_defaults DEFAULT VALUES RETURNING v
CREATE TYPE cd_check AS(a integer,b integer); CREATE TABLE cd_checks(v cd_check CHECK ((v).b>0))
ALTER TYPE cd_check DROP ATTRIBUTE b

INSERT INTO cd_checks VALUES ('(2)'); SELECT v FROM cd_checks
